purpose: Find byte-preserved native device-status sources suitable for real-Rekordbox model and generation experiments.

acceptance_rule.eligible: A byte-preserved UDP status payload with an identified physical model and enough capture provenance to distinguish it from generated, modeled, or model-string-mutated data.
preferred_metadata: source and destination addresses and ports

repositories.name: prodjlink-rs
evidence: README.md calls the testing fixtures modeled after real hardware.
src/testing/fixtures.rs constructs CDJ-3000, CDJ-2000NXS2, and OPUS-QUAD packets with mock builders.

repositories.name: alphatheta-connect
evidence: tests/_data/status-simple.dat is called a real packet by tests/status/utils.spec.ts.
The fixture first appeared in prolink-connect commit ec8b012642bf366f495e0cdd498dc5084057af85 by Evan Purkhiser on 2020-10-11.
The repository retains no parent pcap, packet timestamp, address tuple, or paired keepalive for this fixture.
The 284-byte payload identifies CDJ-2000nexus firmware 1.43 and player 3.

repositories.name: prolink-cpp
evidence: tests/test_packet_parsing.cpp obtains status packets from BuildStatusPacket.
No byte-preserved device-status fixture or capture is committed.

repositories.name: usr-ein/prolink
evidence: README.md identifies the corpus as two physical CDJ-2000NXS players on firmware 1.44.
All exact model strings recovered from the 37 capture files are CDJ-2000nexus; no target modern model string occurs.
The corpus corroborates the already-retained CDJ-2000nexus generation but supplies no XDJ-XZ, XDJ-AZ, XDJ-1000MK2, XDJ-RR/RX2, OPUS-QUAD, or CDJ-3000 payload.

repositories.name: beat-link
evidence: The source documents observed CDJ-3000, XDJ-XZ, XDJ-1000, XDJ-AZ, and OPUS-QUAD behavior.
No pcap, pcapng, or byte-preserved status fixture is committed at the audited revision.

repositories.name: SuperTimecodeConverter
evidence: GitHub issue 12 identifies a physical XDJ-XZ and links a second Wireshark capture recorded after the PC and unit were placed on the same subnet.
The maintainer reports that the corrected capture shows one announcement identity and two player-number data streams.
The capture is not committed to the repository and its Google Drive object currently requires sign-in, so no bytes or hash are retained locally.

acquisition_lead.access_state: requires Google sign-in; local gog token lacks Drive scope

repositories.name: opus-quad-pro-dj-link-analysis
repositories.classification: physical OPUS-QUAD analysis with one retained non-status packet
evidence: The author identifies the source as a physical OPUS-QUAD and documents obtaining CDJ-status traffic after a rekordbox-shaped port-50002 activation request.
pro-dj-link.js preserves the exact first 36-byte OPUS-QUAD packet received on port 50002 as firstPacketOn50002FromOpusQuad.
The retained packet is kind 0x10, not the kind-0x0a player-status payload required by the native model matrix.
Subsequent status packets are relayed dynamically and no pcap, status fixture, firmware, address tuple, or packet timestamp is committed.

repositories.name: Conduction
repositories.classification: independent fixture provenance and protocol implementation
evidence: Its hardware-capture fixtures are unchanged packets from the already-audited Dysentery CDJ-2000nexus corpus and issue attachments.
Its OPUS-QUAD/export-source vectors are explicitly classified as transcribed references rather than public hardware captures.
The provenance document links the OPUS-QUAD analysis but retains no OPUS-QUAD player-status bytes or parent capture.

repositories.name: netBeat
repositories.classification: two corroborating modern hardware status fixtures
evidence: The repository's dated session notes describe a physical XDJ-XZ at 10.255.4.69, two CDJ-class deck identities, a mixer identity, and a gitignored 12 MB JSONL capture made on 2026-04-22.
packages/prolink/test/status.test.ts embeds two complete 292-byte kind-0x0a packets and labels both as real XDJ-XZ captures from that session.
One retained packet is player 1 with an analyzed rekordbox track and master state; the other is player 1 with an unanalyzed track.
The parent JSONL, firmware, packet timestamps, address tuple, and paired keepalive bytes are not committed, so the fixtures remain below captured-verbatim provenance.

reviewed_nonqualifying_leads.name: alphatheta-connect CDJ-3000 Stagehand capture sessions
reviewed_nonqualifying_leads.reported_capture_method: official Stagehand iPad baseline with layer-2 MAC takeover
reviewed_nonqualifying_leads.protocol_plane: Stagehand registration, control, preference, state-report, beat-stream, and announcement traffic
reviewed_nonqualifying_leads.classification: real-hardware semantic evidence outside the Link Export status-source requirement
evidence: The pull request reports physical CDJ-3000 firmware 3.18 capture sessions and offers pcap hex dumps, but neither the pull request nor its comments contains an attachment or raw dump.
The merged commit changes only docs/STAGEHAND.md.
The reported packet kinds belong to the Stagehand control plane and do not supply the ordinary UDP 50002 player-status payload required by the Link Export model matrix.
A recursive scan of the pinned repository tree found no additional CDJ-3000 pcap or byte-preserved status fixture.
